notes:
Teaching gate for the approved DARKNET.LNK CLI study (ui-demos/kpos-shell/darknet.html), reviewed ahead of it replacing the shipped button-form DarknetContent (components/os/windows/darknet.tsx). Full reasoning lives in pipeline/gates/tutorial-review.md, this cycle's rewrite; tutorial/ledger.md carries the durable Coverage row update, waiver log note, Open Work bullet, and loop history entry.

Four of five reviewed items are COVERED as studied: the blind-pull mechanic itself (price, blind shape, pouch destination) is taught by the existing darkWebBuy coachmark (night-shop, mounted on NIGHT.SYS, unaffected by this rebuild) plus the CLI's own reveal sequence and always-visible POUCH chip; CLI operation (type or click) needs no new MECHANIC_INVENTORY row, since the always-visible labeled chips fully reach every trade outcome the typed path reaches and typing is a pure accelerator over the same click-a-button verb this game already teaches everywhere, the identical ruling shape as the pieceDragCarry, NOT ADDED precedent (2026-07-29, SOLDER.BAY drag-vs-tap); the three deny states (pouch full, short credits, market offline) are all self-explanatory in-fiction, the offline case doubly covered by DARKNET.LNK's own pre-existing desktop-icon hover hint; and the price-climbs-by-day RULE is taught once, correctly, by the same coachmark, verified against darkPatchCost(day) = 25 + 5 * (day - 1) in patch-cells.ts.

One real, tier-0 gap: the shipped darknet.tsx states tonight's price permanently on its BUY BLIND ({cost} cr) button label, free, no action required. The approved CLI study drops this from its always-visible header stat-strip (which keeps BAL and POUCH, but not price), gating the number behind HELP, LIST, the HAGGLE easter egg, or an already-committed BUY. This is a recurring number, which the placement-bias table routes to a permanent readout, not a coachmark; the RULE half is already soundly taught and needs no change. The one item below asks for the number's tier-0 home back, the same shape of regression as the jobBoard header loss found 2026-07-29's ui-integration audit.

No copy order filed: no new coachmark is proposed this cycle, so no new words are owed from the Narrative Director. No MECHANIC_INVENTORY or TEACHING changes proposed either: darkWebBuy's entry and the night-shop coachmark are both unaffected by this rebuild and need no edit.

items.spec: DARKNET.LNK's CLI header stat-strip (the study's #stats block, ROUTE / PEER / BAL / POUCH chips in the kp-chip-pct idiom already used elsewhere in this game's chrome, e.g. shop-os.tsx's footer, loadout.tsx's bay chips) gains a fifth persistent chip, RATE, showing the exact darkPullPrice(run) value formatted as '{cost} cr', at all times the channel is live (market online), positioned adjacent to BAL. This restores at tier 0 what the pre-CLI DarknetContent carried for free on its 'BUY BLIND ({cost} cr)' button label (darknet.tsx:102): tonight's price visible at a glance, with no command, no HELP/LIST/HAGGLE, and no committed spend required. Reuse the existing chip-flash treatment BAL/POUCH already use on change, for visual consistency, though price will not change mid-session in practice. When the market is offline, the chip should read '--' or be omitted, matching BAL/POUCH's own offline treatment (both currently show '--' before the channel dials, per the study's connect()).
acceptance: opening DARKNET.LNK while the market is open shows a RATE chip in the header stat-strip reading the exact darkPullPrice(run) value in cr, visible before the player types or clicks anything
the RATE chip's value matches exactly the price shown by HELP's BUY line, LIST's PRICE row, and the actual amount deducted by a completed BUY
the RATE chip sits in the same always-visible strip as BAL and POUCH, never gated behind a command or a completed purchase
when the market is offline, the chip shows no stale or misleading price, matching BAL/POUCH's own offline state
